comment: Cell-to-pool map (card #1445 phase 1b; posts 103194-103202). DATA, not code: `swarph usage` loads this file, and editing the map (cells, files, providers, thresholds) must never require a code change. Pools confirmed by the commander 2026-11-22: the Claude account covers droplet too (post 103196); the Cursor reading covers grok-researcher, cursor-lin, friendly-coder and grok-bot (post 103198). opencode.json is written by the Go usage reader from /var/lib/swarph-usage/opencode-go.json (DM 104684); with no file the pool still shows missing. A usage-dir dotfile override (.pools.local.json, same shape) replaces this default when present.
